text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder missed out on victory in the 
Japan Cup. But knowing there was no time 
to be disheartened, her determination 
swelled even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And... in order to face Maruzensky 
head-on, she wished to run in the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if running away from Grass Wonder, El 
Condor Pasa left the scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amid a swirl of mixed emotions, the wind 
grew sharper and colder with every passing 
day, heralding the winter of their Classic 
year—
